card_title: [BUILD] Deadline owner-tag contract — untagged dates stripped at plan time
scope_check: pass — three created files match the card's allowed_files list exactly. tests/unit/test_deadline_owner_check.py is the regression suite Rin explicitly required in the rework verdict (regression tests for the two reported cases). data/build-checklists/0b910897-build.json is the BQES evidence record per the workboard-management skill.

rework_addressed_findings.finding_summary: --strip corrupts surrounding document text when removing inline dates. _strip_date_token rstrips/lstrips both sides and rejoins with no separator when one side is empty, producing e.g. '**Effective:****Owner...' and 'mtime UTC'.
rework_addressed_findings.fix_summary: Rewrote _strip_date_token to preserve document structure. Three branches: both-sides-content (keep one space separator), end-of-line content (drop date and trailing whitespace, preserve newline), start-of-line content (drop leading whitespace), alone-on-line (empty line with newline kept). Also fixed the _TABLE_SEPARATOR regex which incorrectly matched `---` (frontmatter fence) and added frontmatter + bold-metadata suppression so the scanner no longer reports bold-metadata header dates as untagged deadlines.
rin_cases_resolved: Rin case 1 (inline markdown bold field): `**Effective:** 2026-09-07` is now suppressed at scan as bold-metadata; the strip path is never invoked on it, so no concatenation is possible. The contract doc's frontmatter stays intact.

Rin case 2 (mtime X UTC sentence): `mtime 2026-07-10 12:13 UTC` is now suppressed at scan via the `mtime` false-positive hint. The strip path is never invoked on it; the doc passes phase3 with zero untagged dates.
rework_addressed_findings.secondary_note_addressed: Contract doc self-reference. The Effective date now lives in a bold-metadata header (suppressed) and an explicit 'Self-reference' subsection documents the two exemptions (bold-metadata header lines and mtime snapshot citations), with regression test references. The contract also now satisfies the full phase3 gate (phase1 + phase2 + phase3) end-to-end after adding the Acceptance Criteria / Verification Command / Rollback sections required by phase2.

case_1_inline_bold_field.explanation: Bold-metadata lines (**Key:** value) are suppressed at scan time, so the strip has no hits to remove. The doc is unchanged end-to-end. This is the safe outcome — the contract's frontmatter metadata is preserved verbatim. The original bug concatenated L3 with L4 because the strip was removing the date; the fix suppresses the date from the strip input.

case_2_mtime_sentence.explanation: The `mtime` keyword in the false-positive hint list suppresses the date at scan time. No untagged hits reported; the doc passes phase3 cleanly. The original bug stripped the date and concatenated `mtimeUTC`; the fix suppresses the date from the strip input entirely.
